subject: Syndicated promo voucher issuance — Momentum Accelerator cohort onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@momentumaccel.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@cloudmarketplace.io>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicated voucher request for May cohort

Hi Rohan —

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Momentum is finalizing the May 2028 cohort and we want to include Redwood as the default inference partner for the top 12 teams. Our program model is partner-sourced credits: we handle cohort intake and marketing; partners provide voucher pools that teams can redeem in their first 90-120 days.

Concretely, can Redwood provide a pooled voucher of $15,000 USD (tokens/credits) plus a 90-day trial extension per team (up to 12 teams)? I attached the sponsorship intake and a suggested voucher issuance matrix.

Key asks from us:
- Voucher issuance: single pool assigned to Momentum, redeemable by teams via marketplace link
- Trial extension mechanics: automatic +90 days when voucher accepted
- Program reporting: monthly usage summary and redemption list (email to program@momentumaccel.com)

We need to confirm by Apr 6 to hit onboarding timelines. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the logistics.

Best,
Elena Park
Director, Partnerships
Momentum Accelerator

Attachments: momentum_sponsor_request.pdf (3 pages)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@momentumaccel.com>, Samir Rao <samir@cloudmarketplace.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated voucher request for May cohort

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Putting Vanessa and Rishi on copy to confirm operational and finance constraints. Initial thoughts: $15k pooled credit + 90-day extension per redemptive account should be feasible but we need to validate marketplace issuance flow and matching legal terms.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Vanessa to confirm voucher issuance approach on marketplace and whether we can create a single redeemable pool tied to Momentum's program ID.
2) Rishi to confirm approval path for sponsor credit in Q2 (discount/credits ledger + accounting treatment).
3) I'll prepare a short partner MOU and proposed usage reporting cadence.

Can you confirm whether any teams will require private deployment/backfilled capacity (some cohorts request dedicated pools)? That affects whether we treat some credits as reserved capacity.

I can do a 30-min sync Tue 04/03 11:00PT if that works.

Thanks —
Rohan
Head, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@momentumaccel.com>, Samir Rao <samir@cloudmarketplace.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated voucher request for May cohort

Hi all —

Quick operational notes after checking with Marketplace Engineering: we can create a single voucher pool assigned to Momentum Accelerator and expose a one-click redemption flow for cohort teams. Details:
- Voucher pool: single SKU with $15,000 total value, redeemable per team up to X (we should cap per-team allocation to avoid one team consuming all credits)
- Redemption limit: suggest default cap $1,250/team, adjustable if Momentum approves reallocation
- Trial extension: marketplace can attach a +90 days flag to accounts created via the voucher link (no code changes required)
- Reporting: we can publish a monthly CSV export (redemptions, user emails, usage minutes) to a shared Drive.

Operational open items:
- Legal: need a short sponsor addendum (Rohan, I can draft).
- Accounting: Rishi, how do we book the $15k? Is this a marketing expense or contra-revenue?
- Security: Elena — any teams requesting Private deployment? If yes, we'll need an onboarding lead and possible SLA exceptions.

Attachment: voucher_matrix.xlsx (proposed per-team caps and redemption windows)

Vanessa
Partner Growth, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@momentumaccel.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated voucher request for May cohort

Thanks — quick finance take.

We can approve a $15k sponsor voucher as a marketing-sponsored credit with the following guardrails:
- Book as marketing expense (credit line: MAR-CREDIT-2028)
- Voucher expiry: 6 months from issuance; if Momentum requires 90-day trial extension per account, that's fine — ensure redemption triggers are documented
- Require a short sponsor MOU and an invoice/PO from Momentum for audit trail; if Momentum cannot provide a PO, need approval from Legal for exception
- Cap: we should set a soft per-team allocation of $1,250 and allow Momentum to request reallocations via a single change request to Redwood Partner Ops

I'll approve pending: 1) signed MOU, 2) HubSpot deal update (HD-4921) with expected redemption timeline, 3) confirmation no private-dedicated capacity requests beyond demo accounts.

Rishi
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: redwood_terms_short.pdf

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@momentumaccel.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated voucher request for May cohort — next steps and MOU

Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per the thread above, Redwood can provide a $15,000 pooled voucher with a default per-team cap of $1,250 and a +90 day trial extension on redemption. Rishi has approved from finance pending the short MOU and HubSpot entry. Vanessa will provision the voucher pool on the marketplace and publish the monthly redemption report to the shared Drive.

Action items:
- Elena/Momentum: please review the attached sponsor MOU and return signed by Apr 9. If Momentum prefers a PO instead of the MOU, send PO to billing@redwood.ai.
- Vanessa: provision the voucher SKU and share redemption link by Apr 7.
- Rishi: I’ll update the HubSpot deal and attach the signed MOU when received (HD-4921).

I'll also create a Jira ticket to track issuance and reporting (SUP-1287).

Thanks all — excited to get Momentum cohort onboarded.

Cheers,
Rohan Mehta
Head, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sponsor_mou_draft.docx (1 page)
